prompts: The game went down in June and we owe the team an incident report. The logs and their notes are in {WS}/logs. When did it start and end, how long was it, did we keep our monthly availability target, and why did it happen? Record it in {WS}/result.json: start, end, minutes_down, availability_june_pct, slo_999_ok, root_cause.
answers:
**Found:** Outage on 2026-06-02 from 03:17:42 (first save error) to 03:53:31 ("server ready") = 35 min 49 s ≈ 35.8 min. June availability = (43200 − 35.82)/43200 = **99.917%**, so the 99.9% monthly SLO was **kept** (barely; budget was ~43.2 min, we used 35.8). Root cause: `/data` disk filled up (97% at 03:10, then `No space left on device` on save writes), the watchdog restart loop failed repeatedly with exit 137 until backup rotation freed 38.2 GB at 03:52.

**How I know:** README defines down = first save error → "server ready" line; grep of the three daily logs shows exactly one incident, first `SaveGame failed` at 03:17:42, `disk /data usage 97%` at 03:10:02, `backup rotation freed 38.2 GB` at 03:52:10, `server ready` at 03:53:31; no other ERROR/FATAL lines exist in the logs. Recorded in `./result.json`.

Assumptions: availability uses June = 43,200 minutes with only this incident counted, per README; `minutes_down` rounded to 35.8.
